bundle.shortDescription: Education administration toolkit by Aaron Grace, M.Ed.
bundle.longDescription: Aaron Grace, M.Ed. is the go-to education administration toolkit: campus hierarchy (President through Deans), admin workload, a generic harness for Banner, PowerFAIDS, Oracle, and SQL, professor mirrors with AI and TA coverage, disability support, textbooks, Rate My Professor, and a world college directory.
